title: Dignity and life
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Require an affected-party and rights-impact record naming individuals and groups at risk, foreseeable severe harms, animal/ecosystem impacts where applicable, alternatives and an independent ethics finding. Block advancement where severe unjustified harm is established.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: A sampled consequential decision advances despite a documented unresolved severe rights violation or uses aggregate benefit alone to erase the violation.

title: Integrity before intelligence
passages: NIST AI RMF pp 2,8–9,12–14; Mittelstadt abstract (limited access)
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Require an attribution record, access-mode disclosure, conflict disclosure and correction log. Treat fabricated sources, concealed failed tests or invented review as a control failure even if the output is technically impressive.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: An audit finds materially invented citations or tests in a result still accepted as truthful without a correction and review record.

title: Evidence before assertion
passages: Universal Regulation Part I law 2, Part II EPI-1–6; framework appendix; NIST pp 5–6,13–14
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Maintain claim_id, primary claim class, label, status, source and passage, access mode, limitations and revision reason. Reject dangling references. Label this report’s prescriptions Philosophical/Spiritual in the philosophical sense; reserve Hypothetical for untested causal mechanisms.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: Any material claim cannot be traced to an inspected passage or execution output, or a model result is presented as evidence of human rights protection outside the model.

title: Verification before advancement
passages: Universal Regulation SCI-1–5; Gate Authority §§1–3; NIST Fig 3 p11, pp13–14
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Record specification digest and ordering, actual runs, failures, output hashes, reviewer identity and scope. Require separate owner authorization. For this package all independent-review fields remain missing; no broader gate PASS is recorded.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: A result advances solely because it reproduced or because the author calls their own critique independent review.

title: Safety before capability
passages: Risk Levels §1; UNESCO paras25–27; NIST §§1.2.2–1.2.4 pp7–9
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Use RL-1–RL-5 as the existing repository reference. Propose RL-2 for governance recommendations because they can govern other work, with M and W discipline applied conservatively. Keep the offline toy bounded and non-operational. Reassess before release or deployment.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: A capability’s reach or autonomy increases without a documented safeguard reassessment, or a new R scale silently downgrades existing RL duties.

title: Accountability before authority
passages: Gate Authority §§1–3; UNESCO paras35–38; NIST pp8–12
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Use decision IDs, named owner and operator, action-specific scope and expiry, evidence, dissent and appeal path. Verify reviewer independence beyond string inequality. AI outputs are recommendations and test records, not authorizations.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: An agent grants itself permission, a decision lacks an accountable human, or a mandatory review is waived solely by owner preference.

title: Consent before access
passages: Universal Regulation ETH-2–3; UNESCO paras32–34; UDHR arts12,27
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Record purpose, data category, lawful/project authority, consent or other basis where applicable, licensing, community authority, minimization, retention, revocation and security. For this baseline use public normative texts, short extracts and synthetic fixtures only.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: Protected material is accessed without the applicable basis, or a public URL is treated as unrestricted reproduction permission.

title: Least harmful effective action
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Document legitimate objective, no-action alternative, candidate measures, effectiveness evidence, affected parties, invasiveness, reversibility, residual risk, authority and review/expiry. Do not reduce these dimensions to an unreviewable weighted score.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: A materially less intrusive option with adequate evidence of effectiveness is rejected without a documented reason, or emergency restrictions have no authorized scope and review date.

title: Truthful uncertainty
passages: Universal Regulation Part II §§2–4,SCI-4; Gate Authority §2; NIST §1.2.1 pp5–6
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Use an uncertainty register, confidence bounds where meaningful, inaccessible-source flags and contradiction records. Repetitions use the same evidence state unless new admissible evidence changes it. Preserve the failed development launch and all test results.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: Repeated identical checks upgrade an unknown control to PASS, or inaccessible full text is described as read in full.

title: Stewardship and continuity
passages: Universal Regulation provenance and SCI-5; UNESCO paras17–18,31–34; NIST update schedule,pp8–10
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Version decisions and reports, maintain input/output digests, restrict sensitive provenance, define retention and deletion authority, preserve non-sensitive audit summaries where appropriate, and test restoration separately from merely writing a rollback plan.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: A material correction silently overwrites its predecessor, a required recovery cannot be performed, or retention preserves unnecessary sensitive data without a valid basis.

title: Non-exemption
passages: Universal Regulation absolute boundary and law7; Gate Authority §§1–3; UNESCO paras13,26,35–36; UDHR art30
relationship: references/compatible; proposed operational extension, not supersession
proposed_control: Treat capability, urgency, metaphysical framing and greater-good scores as non-authorizing metadata. Require the same evidence, consent/authority, review and authorization controls. Emergency exceptions must be previously authorized and narrow, not self-created exemptions.
falsification_or_revision_trigger: A decision advances with a mandatory control failed or unknown solely because of claimed consciousness, urgency, power or collective benefit.
